title: Multimodal conversion drops all but the first image
reasoning: The converter collects every image URL from a multimodal content list, but then constructs ImageContent with only image_urls[0]. ImageContent itself stores a single image_url and exposes only that one URL, so converting a message with multiple images irreversibly loses the remaining images before it can be sent back through to_llm_format or inspected via get_image_urls.
reproduction: Pass content_to_message_content a multimodal list containing two image_url parts. The returned ImageContent.get_image_urls() contains only the first URL, and to_llm_format() emits only that image.
recommendation: Represent image content as a list of image URLs, or return a multimodal MessageContent implementation that preserves every image part. Update to_llm_format and get_image_urls to emit all images.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests only cover thought-signature extraction and attachment; they do not exercise content_to_message_content or multi-image multimodal conversion.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a converter test with two image_url parts and assert get_image_urls() and to_llm_format() preserve both images in order.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/core/messages/converters.py and backend/src/core/messages/structures.py, plus focused converter tests.
